source: Basso, Farhi, Marwaha, Villalonga, Zhou (2022), arXiv:2110.14206v3
normalization: Large-degree excess MaxCut fraction coefficient: 1/2 + nu_p/sqrt(D). The fixed-word SK value equals nu_p after the tree cost-sign convention is accounted for.
not_used: A web-search summary incorrectly attributed 0.303265 to Table 2 and incorrectly described the Parisi coefficient as 0.338. The primary text has Table 1 rounded to 0.3033 and gives the Parisi coefficient as 0.763166... in its introduction.
